descriptions.en: A Home Assistant custom integration for bidirectional vehicle telemetry and maintenance reminders with a self-hosted Garage vehicle management server.
descriptions.ko: 셀프호스팅 Garage 차량관리 서버와 차량 텔레메트리·정비 알림을 양방향으로 연결하는 Home Assistant HACS 커스텀 통합구성요소입니다.

categories_review.source: README Features describes car location/RPM/speed/fuel/odometer telemetry, vehicle maintenance reminders and per-vehicle API tokens. Category names verified against official Core taxonomy ec18d8b25d1ee39aa8b85a72a170e42bee33228c.
